video.description:
This video is in Arabic dedicated for arab people so that they understand what's going on.

![4WaiXF2y-opengraph3x.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQma6mD...)

Hive is a new blockchain that was developed by steemian who wanted a better decentralized blockchain, where everyone can grow a community that help in the general growth of the blockchain it self.

In this post and video I will resume what they have mentioned on their post.

The intention of this community-driven fork is to support and build on the strong Steem community values that have made our ecosystem so diverse and exciting.

Existing Steem accounts will appear on the Hive Network as well.

The Hive blockchain launch will be at 10am EST, Friday, March 20th.

All valid STEEM stakeholders will receive a perfectly mirrored balance of their current STEEM holdings in the new HIVE coin. This will include matching amounts of current liquid STEEM, Steem Power, and SBD.

For example: if your Steem account has 10 STEEM, 5 SBD, and 1000 SP, your new Hive account will have 10 HIVE, 5 HBD, and 1000 HP.

You can access your Hive account by simply logging in on the Hive Network using your existing Steem account keys. The first frontend available will be https://hive.blog.

To prevent governance (or funding) attacks, a 30 day delay has been added on crediting vests towards witness and SPS votes. Further governance changes will need to be developed alongside the community.
